name: Price Structure Definition
desc: Segmentation, master-data hierarchy, reference price framework, approval governance.

reqs.title: Part category hierarchy
reqs.plain: Establish commercially appropriate hierarchical categories for all part numbers (including historical parts) with consistent naming. Support category upload if not already in the OEM system.
reqs.ref: C105 Master-data hierarchy gaps

reqs.title: Multi-dimensional pricing
reqs.plain: Support different prices for the same part across market, model, programme, and channel dimensions simultaneously.
reqs.ref: C101 Segmentation framework

reqs.title: Role-based permissions and approval governance
reqs.plain: Tiered access levels per user. When a user lacks authority, automatically trigger an in-system approval loop. Separate admin roles from pricing roles.
reqs.ref: C104 Governance + U14 Approval workflow

reqs.title: Segmentation and pricing rules framework
reqs.plain: Group parts into families and clusters so pricing rules can be applied at scale by segment rather than part by part.
reqs.ref: C101 Segmentation framework

name: Initial Price Creation
desc: New-part pricing, cost-plus / mark-up methods, bulk loads, replacements, bundles.

reqs.title: Bulk repricing at scale
reqs.plain: Handle mass price changes across millions of price points without errors. Include a profit-impact preview and validation before activation.
reqs.ref: C205 Bulk upload + U06

reqs.title: SKU search and handling at scale
reqs.plain: Search and handle millions of individual SKUs without performance degradation. This is a standalone technical non-functional requirement.
reqs.ref: Technology and Integration - Performance

reqs.title: Part linkage - kits, supersessions, variants
reqs.plain: Link related part numbers: parts within a kit, supersession chains, LH/RH variants, and replacement relationships. Price changes must propagate correctly.
reqs.ref: C204 Supersession and linkage breaks

reqs.title: Method-specific pricing with corridor governance
reqs.plain: Support multiple calculation methods (cost-plus, mark-up, fixed, value-based) per segment with configurable price corridors enforced automatically.
reqs.ref: C107 + U05 Method-specific pricing

name: Central Price Adjustments
desc: Cost-triggered repricing, surcharges, tariffs, FX threshold recalculation, channel linkage.

reqs.title: Cost visibility - PIR, MAC, tariffs, freight
reqs.plain: Surface Purchase Information Records and Moving Average Cost from SAP as live as possible. Tariffs and freight elements must also be visible to support pricing decisions.
reqs.ref: C301 Cost-change triggers + C304 Surcharge handling

reqs.title: Surcharge handling - remanufacture return
reqs.plain: Support surcharges against specific parts such as remanufacture-return incentives. All downstream pricing systems must handle the surcharge price correctly.
reqs.ref: C304 + U13 Return-deposit pricing

reqs.title: FX threshold-triggered recalculation
reqs.plain: Automatically recalculate affected market prices when FX rates move beyond a configurable threshold - without manual intervention.
reqs.ref: C302 FX-rate exposure + U07 Central price adjustments

reqs.title: Cost and price change monitoring
reqs.plain: Monitor cost and price changes over time by part, market, and category - surfacing where margins are drifting or action is needed.
reqs.ref: C305 + U08 Central pricing and action reporting

name: HQ to Market Handover
desc: Releasing approved central prices to markets - controlled, transparent, with confirmed receipt.

reqs.title: No discrepancy across connected systems
reqs.plain: No discrepancy between the pricing tool and downstream systems such as the ordering system and dealer DMS. The storage strategy across all systems must keep prices consistent through the full handover chain.
reqs.ref: C404 Disconnected systems + C805 Validity-date sync

reqs.title: Separation of approval, communication, and activation dates
reqs.plain: The system must cleanly separate when a price is approved, when it is communicated to markets, and when it activates in operational systems. These are three distinct dates - conflating them is a common failure mode.
reqs.ref: C803 Timing entangled + U09 HQ to Market handover

name: Market Price Derivation
desc: Local retail and dealer-net derivation from central prices, applying FX, markups, corridors, and local rules.

reqs.title: Independent retail and wholesale calculation
reqs.plain: Retail and wholesale prices must be calculated independently. Some OEMs derive wholesale from retail rather than the reverse - this dependency must be configurable.
reqs.ref: U01 Pricing methods + U11 Dealer-net derivation

reqs.title: Rule-based pricing with margin restrictions
reqs.plain: Enforce rule-based pricing: min/max rules, margin floors, and margin restrictions. Prices that would breach these rules must be flagged or blocked before activation.
reqs.ref: C503 Corridors + C603 Margin floor + U01

reqs.title: Automatic rounding and psychological pricing
reqs.plain: Automatically apply rounding rules to final prices, for example converting 19.88 to 19.99. Multiple rounding rule sets must be configurable per market or segment.
reqs.ref: C106 Rounding inconsistency + U02 Central rounding rules

reqs.title: Price waterfall with scoring and corridor logic
reqs.plain: Market price derivation must follow a defined waterfall from European list price through country list price, dealer net, to customer price - with margin scoring, competitive corridor checks, and FX application at each stage.
reqs.ref: U11 Market price derivation + C501 to C506

name: Market Price Changes
desc: Targeted local adjustments, differentiated increases, simulation toward targets, approval workflows.

reqs.title: Price performance monitoring and alerting
reqs.plain: Alert users to pricing events: a margin has dropped below acceptable levels, a price has been manually overridden and not reverted, or performance is drifting from target.
reqs.ref: C606 Weak local performance analysis + C605 No target-seeking simulation

reqs.title: Simulation and scenario management
reqs.plain: Users must simulate price changes - iterating toward a margin or revenue target - without committing them. Named scenarios must be saveable and shareable. Approval timing must be separable from activation timing.
reqs.ref: C605 No target-seeking simulation + U15 Simulate and conduct general increase

reqs.title: Notes, comments, and team coordination flags
reqs.plain: Users must attach notes, comments, and coordination flags to price records and changes so the team can track reasoning without going to email.
reqs.ref: UX feature - not currently in canvas

name: Campaigns and Special Prices
desc: Promotional prices, key-account specials, distributor lists, dealer bonuses, agreements.

reqs.title: Campaign pricing with margin floor and auto-revert
reqs.plain: Temporary promotional prices must have a defined validity window, minimum-margin check before activation, and automatic reversion when the campaign ends. No manual cleanup required.
reqs.ref: C701 Campaign pricing uncontrolled + U16 Campaign and promotion pricing

reqs.title: Special prices for distributors, importers, key accounts
reqs.plain: Capture and maintain distributor, importer, and key-account price lists with eligibility control. Requests must be governed, time-bound, and validated against margin floors.
reqs.ref: C702 Special and regional price requests + U17

name: Price Publication and Distribution
desc: Publishing approved prices to ERP, logistics, invoicing - with timing, receipt confirmation, consistency.

reqs.title: Multi-system price consistency and distribution
reqs.plain: Reliably publish approved prices to all consuming systems - ERP, ordering, logistics, DMS - with validated timing. Confirm receipt. Surface cross-market price differences and validity mismatches.
reqs.ref: C801 Publication fragile + C805 Cross-market differences + U18

reqs.title: Internal price lists and Warranty Charge Back
reqs.plain: Generate and distribute internal price lists by rule, including Warranty Charge Back values and internal regional-account prices. These are distinct from the retail and wholesale distribution chain.
reqs.ref: U18 Publication + U19 Market price distribution

reqs.title: Distribution timing separated from approval and activation
reqs.plain: Approval date, communication date to markets, and system activation date must be three separately controllable dates. Distributing too early or activating unannounced are recurring failure modes.
reqs.ref: C803 Timing and communication entangled

name: Audit, History and Compliance
desc: Full traceability of every price change - who, what, when, why - with long-term retention.

reqs.title: Full audit trail and change logging
reqs.plain: Every price change, approval, and manual action must be fully logged with a unique reference, timestamp, user, and rationale. This requirement appears in every automotive aftermarket RFP.
reqs.ref: U20 Audit trail - recurs in every RFP

reqs.title: End-to-end traceability to rule and cost
reqs.plain: A price point must be traceable all the way back to the rule, driver, cost element, and approval that produced it. The question how did we arrive at this price must be answerable from the system.
reqs.ref: C902 No end-to-end traceability

reqs.title: Retention, deletion, and data-subject compliance
reqs.plain: Data retention periods, often 10 to 15 years in automotive, and deletion obligations including GDPR data-subject requests must be enforced systematically rather than managed manually.
reqs.ref: C904 Retention and deletion not enforced
